name: islo
description: Runs the agent's shell commands in a sandbox that holds a copy of the project instead of on your machine. Local with OpenShell by default; Islo cloud sandboxes if you select them. If no sandbox can be reached the command does not run (exit code 125). CoCo CLI on macOS and Linux. Prereqs: python3 (3.9+) and either the openshell CLI with a reachable gateway or the islo CLI, signed in. See SETUP.md.
